```{r}
# Load the dataset
control_data <- Read10X("~/Downloads/Crean`s/Control/filtered_feature_bc_matrix/filtered_feature_bc_matrix")

#print(control_data)

tgfb_data <- Read10X("~/Downloads/Crean`s/TFGB/filtered_feature_bc_matrix/filtered_feature_bc_matrix/")

#print(tgfb_data)

# Initialize the Seurat object with the raw (non-normalized data).
control <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = control_data, 
                              project = "Control", 
                              min.cells = 3, 
                              min.features = 350)

tgfb <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = tgfb_data,
                           project = "TGFB",
                           min.cells = 3,
                           min.features = 350)


control$condition <- "Control"
tgfb$condition <- "TGFB"
#print(control)
```



```{r}
## QC and Process each sample
control[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(control, pattern = "^MT-")
tgfb[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(tgfb, pattern = "^MT-")

#Vizualize using violin plot before QC
VlnPlot(control, features = c("nFeature_RNA","nCount_RNA", "percent.mt"), ncol = 3)
control <- subset(control, subset =  nFeature_RNA > 350 & nCount_RNA >500    & percent.mt < 25)
VlnPlot(control, features = c("nFeature_RNA", "nCount_RNA", "percent.mt"),  ncol = 3)

#Visualize using violin plot

tgfb <- subset(tgfb, subset =  nFeature_RNA > 350 & nCount_RNA >500   & percent.mt < 25)
VlnPlot(tgfb, features = c("nFeature_RNA", "nCount_RNA", "percent.mt"),  ncol = 3)

print(control)
print(tgfb)
```

```{r}
#Data transformation for overdispersion in scRNA-seq using SCTransform

control <- SCTransform(control, method = "glmGamPoi", vars.to.regress = "percent.mt",verbose = T,)
tgfb<- SCTransform(tgfb, method = "glmGamPoi", vars.to.regress = "percent.mt",verbose = T,)


#List your samples
samples.list = c("control","tgfb")
sample.list <- c(control, tgfb)

#Merge the processed objects together
seurat <- merge(x = control, y = c(tgfb), add.cell.ids = samples.list)


#pick up 2000 features for integration
obj.features <- SelectIntegrationFeatures(object.list = sample.list, nfeatures = 2000)
VariableFeatures(seurat[["SCT"]]) <- obj.features

```

```{r}

# Perform trajectory inference

library(monocle3)
library(SeuratWrappers)

# Convert subsetted Seurat object to Monocle3
cds <- SeuratWrappers::as.cell_data_set(fibro_myofibro_sub)

# Preprocess and reduce dimensions
cds <- preprocess_cds(cds, num_dim = 50)
cds <- reduce_dimension(cds, reduction_method = "UMAP")
cds <- cluster_cells(cds)
cds <- learn_graph(cds)
cds <- order_cells(cds)

# Plot trajectory
plot_cells(cds, color_cells_by = "pseudotime", show_trajectory_graph = TRUE)


colnames(colData(cds))

```

```{r}

# Define 10 genes of interest (replace with your genes)
genes_of_interest <- c("ACTA2", "COL1A1", "VIM", "FN1", "PDGFRB", 
                       "POSTN")
# Subset Seurat object to include only these cell types
fibro_subset <- subset(seurat.annotated, idents = c("Fibroblast 1", "Fibroblast 2", "Myofibroblast"))

# Extract scaled expression data for the selected genes
expr_matrix <- GetAssayData(fibro_subset, layer =   "scale.data")[genes_of_interest, ]

# Convert to a dataframe for visualization
expr_df <- as.data.frame(expr_matrix)

library(pheatmap)

# Generate heatmap
pheatmap(expr_df, cluster_rows = TRUE, cluster_cols = TRUE, scale = "row",
         main = "Heatmap of 10 Genes in Fibroblast and Myofibroblast",
         color = colorRampPalette(c("blue", "white", "red"))(50))

ggsave("heatmap_fibroblast_myofibroblast.png", width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300)

```




```{r}
# Assign active identities (correct cell annotations)
metadata <- seurat.annotated@meta.data
metadata$cell_type <- as.character(Idents(seurat.annotated))  # Convert factor to character for proper labeling

# Count the number of cells per annotation per condition
cell_counts <- metadata %>%
  group_by(condition, cell_type) %>%
  summarise(count = n(), .groups = "drop")

# Convert to dataframe
cell_counts_df <- as.data.frame(cell_counts)

# Save to CSV
write.csv(cell_counts_df, "cell_counts_by_condition.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# Generate the bar plot with correct cell type labels
ggplot(cell_counts_df, aes(x = cell_type, y = count, fill = condition)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "dodge") +
  theme_classic() +  # White background
  labs(title = "Cell Type Distribution for Control and TGFB",
       x = "Cell Type",
       y = "Cell Count") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1))

# Save the plot
ggsave("cell_annotation_barplot.png", width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300)

```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)

# Step 1: Get expression data
plot_data <- FetchData(sub_obj, vars = genes_to_plot) %>%
  mutate(cluster = Idents(sub_obj))

# Step 2: Reshape to long format
plot_data_long <- pivot_longer(
  plot_data,
  cols = all_of(genes_to_plot),
  names_to = "gene",
  values_to = "expression"
)

# Step 3: Factor levels
plot_data_long$cluster <- factor(plot_data_long$cluster, levels = names(cluster_colors))
plot_data_long$gene <- factor(plot_data_long$gene, levels = genes_to_plot)

# Step 4: Faceted violin plot
ggplot(plot_data_long, aes(x = cluster, y = expression, fill = cluster)) +
  geom_violin(scale = "width", trim = TRUE, width = 0.8) +
  facet_wrap(~ gene, ncol = 3, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cluster_colors) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +  # Increase base font size
  labs(
    title = "Expression of Selected Genes",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Expression"
  ) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),  # ← Bigger facet titles
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 11, face = "bold"),  # ← Cluster names
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10)
  )


ggsave(filename = "~/Downloads/Crean`s/Expression2_subtypes.png", dpi = 600, width = 8, height = 6)
```

```{r}
# Load required libraries
library(Seurat)
library(SeuratWrappers)
library(monocle3)
library(ggplot2)

# Step 1: Subset Seurat object to 4 clusters
clusters_of_interest <- c("Fibroblast 1", "Fibroblast 2", "Myofibroblast", "Stroma 1")
sub_seurat <- subset(sub_obj, idents = clusters_of_interest)

# Step 2: Convert to Monocle3 CellDataSet
cds <- as.cell_data_set(sub_seurat)

# Step 3: Add cluster labels
cds@colData$cluster <- Idents(sub_seurat)

# Step 4: Transfer UMAP embeddings
cds@int_colData@listData$reducedDims$UMAP <- Embeddings(sub_seurat, "umap")

# Step 5: Re-cluster and learn the trajectory graph
cds <- cluster_cells(cds, reduction_method = "UMAP")
cds <- learn_graph(cds, use_partition = FALSE)

# Step 6: Choose root cell (from Fibroblast 1)
root_cell <- colnames(sub_seurat)[which(Idents(sub_seurat) == "Fibroblast 1")[1]]
cds <- order_cells(cds, root_cells = root_cell)

# Step 7: Plot trajectory (no extra branches labeled)
plot_cells(
  cds,
  color_cells_by = "cluster",
  label_groups_by_cluster = TRUE,
  label_leaves = TRUE,
  label_branch_points = FALSE,   # <-- hide extra branching nodes
  graph_label_size = 4
) +
  ggtitle("Trajectory Inference: 4 Fibroblast Clusters") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 14))

```
